title: Income Tax Department Opens Foreign Assets Disclosure Window for Small Taxpayers (FAST-DS)
content:
# Income Tax Department Opens Foreign Assets Disclosure Window for Small Taxpayers (FAST-DS)

Ek important update hai. Government ne **Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers – Disclosure Scheme, 2026 (FAST-DS)** announce kiya hai, jo aaj, **August 16, 2026**, se shuru ho raha hai. This is a one-time opportunity for eligible small taxpayers to regularize their foreign assets and income.

The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne **Notification No. 114/2026 dated August 14, 2026** ke through is scheme ke rules notify kiye hain.

Here are the key details:

*   **Scheme Name:** Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers – Disclosure Scheme, 2026 (FAST-DS).
*   **Effective Date:** August 16, 2026.
*   **Last Date for Declaration:** December 31, 2026.
*   **Eligibility:** This scheme is aimed at small taxpayers, including students, young professionals, tech employees, and relocated Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) who might have unknowingly missed disclosing eligible foreign assets or income.
*   **Categories of Disclosure:** The scheme offers two main categories for declaration:
    *   **Category 1:** For undisclosed foreign income or assets jo pehle tax nahi kiye gaye the. Ismein, aggregate value ₹1 crore se zyada nahi honi chahiye (as of March 31, 2026). Taxpayers ko 60% amount pay karna hoga (30% tax + 30% additional income tax as penalty).
    *   **Category 2:** For foreign assets (aggregate value up to ₹5 crore) jo already taxed income se acquired kiye the ya jab taxpayer non-resident tha, but Income Tax Return (ITR) mein report nahi kiye gaye the. Iske liye ₹1 lakh ki flat fee pay karni hogi.
*   **Valuation Date:** All foreign assets under the scheme will be valued as of March 31, 2026.
*   **Immunity:** Valid declaration aur payment karne par, taxpayers ko Black Money (Undisclosed Foreign Income and Assets) and Imposition of Tax Act, 2015 ke तहत further tax, penalty aur prosecution se immunity milegi.
*   **Filing Process:** Declarations online, Form 1 mein electronically file kiye jayenge.
